issue.title: angular2/forms: Validators.required is missing

repository.name: DefinitelyTyped
repository.description: The repository for high quality TypeScript type definitions.

issue.body:
Hi everyone,
`typescript Validators.required` seems to be missing from `angular2.d.ts`.

Also something I don't understand is why I have to import Validator from `angular2/angular2` and not `angular2/forms`?

issue.title: resolveAndCreate does not exist on Injector in angular.d.ts

labels.name: open for contributions
labels.description: An issue that is suitable for a community contributor (based on its complexity/scope).

issue.body: It seems like the static method `resolveAndCreate` is not present in the DefinitelyTyped typings for angular.d.ts.
